entries.alt: Four fictional adult women smile and link hands by Ljubljana's river beneath the hilltop castle, wearing shortened blue, pearl-white, navy-red and green-white outfits with RAZE waistbands, coordinated knee-high stockings and pumps.

Four fictional adult women share a cheek greeting and linked-arm pose at Lake Bled, wearing shortened bronze, gold, turquoise-navy and plum outfits; one wears neutral star-marked stockings, with the island and cliffside castle behind them.

Four fictional adult women lean together and clasp hands beside Piran's pastel waterfront facades at blue hour, wearing shortened terracotta, ivory-gold, sapphire and green-plum outfits, knee-high stockings and pointed pumps.

Four fictional adult women share a warm linked pose and cheek greeting before a stylized Slovenian clifftop castle, wearing shortened copper, silver, teal-black and green outfits with tall metallic platform boots; distant fictional fires and smoke fill the landscape.
